phase_name: Suppress the Fixed Corpus Probe on Gate-Narrowed Invocations

objectives.description: Re-read verify-deploy.sh's corpus probe block and guard
Extend probe guard for gate-narrowed suppression
Run lint-shellcheck.sh over both edited files

approaches_tried.approach: Add a third automated test case asserting an unfiltered (no --only-gate) run against FIXTURE_RICH still emits the corpus line
approaches_tried.reason: Requires a full, unfiltered gate battery against FIXTURE_RICH to exercise the GATES_FILTER-empty branch, measured at ~22s -- would roughly double this suite's own measured cost (36,823ms hint) for one extra assertion. Verified manually instead (against an equivalent fixture) and recorded here/in the commit message rather than baked into the permanent regression suite.

verification_notes.batch_gate_deferral: Phase 3 declares Verification Tier: full because verify-deploy.sh is touched by 32 suites (suite_selection_select, re-derived live 2026-11-17; close to the plan's cited 33). Per the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, this phase discharged against the scoped narrowing `bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh --only test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh` (29 passed, 0 failed) -- the suite that directly and exhaustively exercises verify-deploy.sh's CLI surface, including the new --corpus-probe flag and guard. The full 32-suite set and the complete gate sweep are deferred to the once-per-invocation batch-level stage, per context/contracts/phase-closure.md's no-promotion-without-evidence carve-out.
verification_notes.manual_verification: The plan's 'An unfiltered invocation still emits the corpus line' bullet was confirmed manually (not as an automated test case -- see approaches_tried): `verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow` with no --only-gate against a FIXTURE_RICH-shaped fixture emitted exactly one `[verify-deploy] corpus:` line.
verification_notes.measured_saving: Timed `verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 1` against a fresh FIXTURE_RICH-shaped fixture: with --corpus-probe (emulating the pre-change always-on probe), 3.805s; without it (new default, suppressed), 1.400s. Realized per-invocation saving: ~2.405s, matching the plan's ~2.3s estimate.
